escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (RCE)
escalations.impact: Any code parsing untrusted protocol buffer definitions can execute arbitrary code
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker supplies malformed .proto file to any gRPC-backed endpoint; protobufjs parses it and executes attacker-controlled code in the server process
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs @grpc/grpc-js — or audit whether @grpc/grpc-js is actually needed; removing it eliminates this entire chain
escalations.escalate_reason: Code execution vulnerability — requires security-team triage before any mitigation

escalations.title: vitest UI Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution
escalations.impact: Vitest UI server listens without authentication — any file on the machine (secrets, source code, .env) is readable; code execution also possible
escalations.exploit_scenario: Developer runs `vitest --ui` on CI or a shared machine; attacker on the same network GETs `http://localhost:51204/.../../../.env` and retrieves all secrets without credentials
escalations.escalate_reason: Information disclosure + code execution — secrets exfiltration risk on any machine running the UI test runner

p1.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot — portal/ never scanned
p1.impact: CI gate reports PASSED while 86% of the codebase (portal/) is never inspected for requirement traceability violations
p1.exploit_scenario: Developer adds untraced code or spec-violating patterns to portal/; CI gate passes; audit detects QO-002 style violations only manually
p1.fix: Add 'portal' to source_dirs list at line 69; pin plan with --file Plans/dev-workflow-platform/requirements.md

p1.title: 6 orphaned FR IDs with no backing spec or plan
p1.impact: FR-090 through FR-095 referenced in RunsTab.tsx, RunDetailRow.tsx, types.ts, api/client.ts — no corresponding entry in Specifications/ or Plans/; violates spec-first mandate
p1.exploit_scenario: Features built without specs cannot be validated, tested against requirements, or safely changed — regression risk is unquantifiable
p1.fix: Create Plans/orchestrator-ui-runs/requirements.md defining FR-090–FR-095 with acceptance criteria

p2.title: Direct DB calls in route handler — teamDispatches.ts
p2.impact: Business logic coupled to transport layer; untestable in isolation; violates 'No direct DB calls from route handlers' architecture rule
p2.fix: Create portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts and move all db.prepare() calls there

p2.title: Three silent .catch(() => {}) blocks — errors swallowed with no logging
p2.impact: RepoSelector.tsx:20, FeatureRequestDetail.tsx:80, BugDetail.tsx:82 — repo list failures silently ignored; no user feedback, no log entry; violates 'Never swallow errors silently' rule
p2.fix: Replace .catch(() => {}) with .catch(err => { console.error('[component] repos.list failed:', err); setError(err.message) }) or equivalent toast notification

p2.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md has 0% implementation traceability
p2.impact: FR-TMP-001–010 define the full risk-classification/Playwright/auto-PR/auto-merge pipeline. Zero Verifies: FR-TMP-* comments exist anywhere in Source/ or portal/
p2.fix: If feature lives in platform/, add a note to the spec; otherwise create implementation with traceability comments

p2.fix: Remove @grpc/grpc-js if unused (eliminates chain) or update to handlebars@>=4.7.9
